title: The Hour Before Boarding
lessons: what you reach for when no one is selling a solution
readiness can mean preparation or permission to pause

text: Gate 34 just delayed itself into an hour.
Outlets, fluorescent weather, and a window full of planes leaving without me.
Nobody's asking what I need. I get to find out.

choices.text: Open the book I packed. Read until they call boarding.
Check the gate, charge everything, make a small plan.

text: The boarding call interrupts a paragraph, not a crisis.
I close the book with a finger holding my place.
For a few minutes, that's all the certainty I need.
